    2026

    An AI cognitive twin for sleep and focus

    NoctaLink connects sleep and EEG biomarkers with behavioral check-ins to model cognitive workload, fatigue, and readiness. Its dashboard pairs neuro-cognitive analytics with an interactive 3D Cognitive Twin and personalized recovery guidance.

    Role: Full-stack Developer

    NoctaLink connects sleep and EEG biomarkers with behavioral check-ins to model cognitive workload, fatigue, and readiness. Its dashboard pairs neuro-cognitive analytics with an interactive 3D Cognitive Twin and personalized recovery guidance.

    CrossWise

    Project 3

    2025

    Predict maize hybrid traits from genomic and environmental data

    CrossWise evaluates virtual maize crosses using SNP markers, biological features, and environmental context. Its machine-learning pipeline predicts multiple hybrid traits, ranks candidate combinations, and uses SHAP explanations to make model outputs easier to interpret.

    Role: Co-creator / ML & full-stack contributor

    CrossWise evaluates virtual maize crosses using SNP markers, biological features, and environmental context. Its machine-learning pipeline predicts multiple hybrid traits, ranks candidate combinations, and uses SHAP explanations to make model outputs easier to interpret.

    Stack: Python, Random Forest, Flask, MongoDB, SHAP

    Model candidate parent combinations from SNP data, derive genomic compatibility features, and incorporate environmental factors such as temperature, rainfall, and humidity. Results can rank candidates across yield potential, drought tolerance, disease resistance, grain quality, and maturity while providing feature-level explanations. An ML-backed web platform combining a prediction API, an interface for exploring candidate crosses, and model-explanation tooling to support more transparent breeding decisions.

    Visit CrossWise

    Cadenza

    Project 4

    2026

    An AI vocal coach built around measurable progress

    Cadenza analyzes singing performances through pitch tracking, vocal-stem separation, tempo-aware alignment, and explainable scoring. A native Android app presents sessions and coaching, while a FastAPI backend powers acoustic analysis and a web showcase demonstrates the experience.

    Role: Android Developer

    Cadenza analyzes singing performances through pitch tracking, vocal-stem separation, tempo-aware alignment, and explainable scoring. A native Android app presents sessions and coaching, while a FastAPI backend powers acoustic analysis and a web showcase demonstrates the experience.

    Stack: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, FastAPI, Demucs, Librosa

    Compare a singer's recording with a reference performance. Demucs separates vocals from accompaniment, pYIN tracks fundamental pitch, and Dynamic Time Warping aligns performances with different timing. A weighted score breaks feedback into pitch accuracy, timing/onset accuracy, and pitch stability, with Gemini-powered personalized coaching. A native Android client works with an audio-analysis API and DSP/ML pipeline, with a separate React-based web experience for the product showcase.

    Visit Cadenza

    Role: Developer
